Founder.capability_summary: Full permanent deletion authority reserved exclusively for Founder role.

ManagingDirector.capability_summary: Can initiate deletion requests for Founder review, but cannot execute permanent deletion.

GeneralManager.capability_summary: READ_WRITE_NO_DELETE — Full operational management without permanent deletion or purge capabilities.

actions_summary: Removed 'project:delete' permission from General Manager role in RBAC security engine matrix.

Verified General Manager permissions: View ('project:view'), Create ('project:create'), Edit ('project:update') enabled.
Enforced explicit blockage for General Manager on Delete ('project:delete'), Force Delete ('project:force_delete'), and Purge ('project:purge').
